environment_note_recorded.observation: Next 16 dev mode injects <style data-next-hide-fouc>body{display:none}</style> and removes it via a requestAnimationFrame callback (next/dist/client/dev/fouc.js). In a backgrounded ZCode in-app-browser tab rAF does not fire, so the page can stay blank (body hidden) even though React hydrated; locator clicks then hit <html> and do nothing. A screenshot (forced compositor frame) runs the pending rAF callback and reveals the page.
environment_note_recorded.classification: environment/automation quirk of the harness, NOT a product defect: visible tabs fire rAF continuously; worlds 1-2 were unaffected while foregrounded. Recorded per the work-order rule to capture environment limits rather than mislabel them.
environment_note_recorded.impact_on_this_run: one forced-frame screenshot needed per new backgrounded tab before interacting; no product assertion was weakened
